phases.objective: Prove that one mounted Tenant request resolves Context Kernel authority and uses one canonical repository instance for the exact operation through immutable-plan consumption, prepared/result/readback journaling, reconciliation, and Tenant-safe readback.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact Tenant operation completes and the same repository instance records the consumed immutable plan, prepared/result/readback journal, reconciliation result, and Tenant-safe readback bindings.
steps: Create one Tenant operation with its immutable plan, approval evidence, execution lease, adapter, one-shot enablement, and canonical in-memory repository.
Mount the Tenant route with Context Kernel and effective-authority resolution bound to that exact operation.
Submit one expected-SHA-bound Tenant request to the mounted apply-plan endpoint.
Read the exact operation back from the same repository object supplied to the runtime.
Require completed operation state, consumed immutable plan with unchanged bindings, unchanged append-only approvals, and prepared/result/readback journal phases for the same run and plan.
Require one reconciliation record and bind the Tenant-safe response to the same operation, run, plan, outcome, and result digest.
Keep provider dispatch, live mutation, SQL Apply, deployment, Production readiness, and secrets disabled.
assertions: The mounted request and post-request readback use the same repository object and operation ID.
The immutable plan bindings remain unchanged while its single-use consumed state advances.
Approval record digests remain append-only and unchanged.
Prepared, result, and readback journal records persist for the same operation, run, and plan.
One reconciliation result matches the Tenant-safe response outcome and result digest.
Cross-Tenant requests, request-side authority injection, and expected-SHA drift fail before mutation.
Provider dispatch, live mutation, Production readiness, and secrets remain false.

phases.objective: Preserve the shared-operation-state journey while adding cancellation, lease release, approval revocation, bounded retry, and operator-visible state-transition coverage.
Extend the same mounted shared-state operation with fault injection, worker restart recovery, unknown-outcome reconciliation, and checkpoint restoration.
Run the same journey against one separately authorized non-production Tenant target after repository-only MVP promotion.
This bounded synthetic-runtime proof grants no live provider, migration, deployment, or Production authority.
